entrance: In the mountains just north of Pyrewood Village, at /way 44.5 68.0. A wooden bridge leads to the gate of the keep.

1654.objective: Collect Whitestone Oak Lumber, Bailor's Refined Ore Shipment, Jordan's Smithing Hammer and a Kor Gem for Jordan Stilwell at the gates of Ironforge.
1654.note: A Paladin quest at the end of the Tome of Valor chain. The hammer lies in Shadowfang Keep, the lumber comes from The Deadmines and the Kor Gem from Blackfathom Deeps.

1098.objective: Find Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent inside the keep.
1098.note: Adamant is the prisoner you free after Rethilgore. Vincent's body lies to the right of the stairs into the courtyard, and the quest is handed in there.

1013.objective: Bring The Book of Ur to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Apothecarium.
1013.note: The book lies on a shelf in the room of Fenrus the Devourer.

1014.objective: Kill Archmage Arugal and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

1740.objective: Bring 3 Soran'ruk Fragments and 1 Large Soran'ruk Fragment to Doan Karhan in The Barrens.
1740.note: A Warlock quest. The large fragment drops from the Shadowfang Darksouls in the keep, the small ones from the Twilight Acolytes in Blackfathom Deeps.
